tools.name: erpnext_revenue_vs_orders

tools.name: erpnext_stock_treemap

group_by.description: Group by item or warehouse (default: item)

tools.name: erpnext_product_radar

tools.name: erpnext_price_vs_qty

tools.name: erpnext_kpi_revenue
tools.description: KPI card: total Sales Order revenue for the current month, with delta % vs previous month and sparkline of last 6 months.

tools.name: erpnext_kpi_outstanding
tools.description: KPI card: total outstanding receivables from submitted Sales Invoices with outstanding_amount > 0. Shows count of open invoices.

tools.name: erpnext_kpi_orders
tools.description: KPI card: count and total value of Sales Orders created this month, with delta % vs last month.

tools.name: erpnext_kpi_gross_margin
tools.description: KPI card: estimated gross margin % based on Sales Order revenue vs valuation rate from stock (Bin). Margin = (revenue - cost) / revenue * 100.

tools.name: erpnext_kpi_overdue

tools.name: erpnext_sales_funnel
tools.description: Sales funnel from Lead → Opportunity → Quotation → Sales Order. Shows count and value at each stage with conversion rates between stages.

tools.name: erpnext_ar_aging
tools.description: Accounts Receivable Aging — stacked bar showing outstanding invoices by customer, grouped into aging buckets (0-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days). Shows who owes you money and for how long.

tools.name: erpnext_gross_profit

tools.name: erpnext_profit_loss

tools.name: erpnext_file_download
tools.description: Download one ERPNext attachment for the document viewer. The tool accepts a File ID, verifies its document attachment, and returns one embedded binary resource.

tools.name: erpnext_file_upload
tools.description: Upload base64-encoded file content and attach it to any ERPNext document. Files are private by default.

content_base64.description: File content as standard base64 (not a data URL).

attached_to_doctype.description: DocType of the document to attach the file to.

attached_to_name.description: Name/ID of the document to attach the file to.

attached_to_field.description: Optional Attach or Attach Image field to populate with the uploaded file.

is_private.description: Whether the attachment is private. Defaults to true.

tools.name: erpnext_doc_create
tools.description: Create any ERPNext document. Works on any DocType including master data (Company, Item Group, UOM, Territory, Customer Group, Supplier Group, Warehouse Type, etc.). For DocTypes with 'Prompt' naming, include a 'name' field in data. Returns the created document.

data.description: Document fields as key-value pairs. Include 'name' for DocTypes with Prompt naming.

tools.name: erpnext_doc_update
tools.description: Update any ERPNext document (partial update). Works on any DocType. Pass doctype (e.g. 'Customer', 'Sales Order'), the document name, and the fields to change. Returns the updated document.

data.description: Fields to update as key-value pairs. Only provided fields will be changed.

tools.name: erpnext_doc_delete
tools.description: Delete any ERPNext document. Only Draft documents can usually be deleted. For submitted documents, use cancel first. Works on any DocType.

tools.name: erpnext_doc_submit
tools.description: Submit any ERPNext document (changes status from Draft to Submitted). Applies to submittable DocTypes like Sales Order, Purchase Order, Sales Invoice, etc. Calls frappe.client.submit via the Frappe method API.

tools.name: erpnext_doc_cancel
tools.description: Cancel any ERPNext submitted document (changes status to Cancelled). Applies to submittable DocTypes like Sales Order, Purchase Order, Sales Invoice, etc. Calls frappe.client.cancel via the Frappe method API.

tools.name: erpnext_doc_get
tools.description: Get any ERPNext document by DocType and name. Useful for DocTypes not covered by dedicated tools. Returns the full document with all fields.

tools.name: erpnext_doc_list
tools.description: List any ERPNext documents by DocType. Useful for DocTypes not covered by dedicated tools. Supports field selection, filters (as JSON array), and limit.

fields.description: Fields to fetch (default: ['name', 'modified']). Use ['*'] for all fields.

filters.description: Frappe filters as array of [fieldname, operator, value] tuples, or [child doctype, fieldname, operator, value] to filter on a child table. Values may be strings, numbers, booleans, null, or string/number arrays for in/not in. Example: [["status","=","Open"],["company","=","Acme"]]

tools.name: erpnext_doc_assign
tools.description: Assign any ERPNext document to one or more users through Frappe's native assignment workflow (per-assignee ToDo, _assign sync, permission sharing, native notifications). Works on any DocType (e.g. 'Task', 'Issue', 'Opportunity'). Idempotent: re-assigning an already-assigned user returns the existing ToDo without re-notifying.

assign_to.description: User email or non-empty array of user emails to assign

notify_user.description: Frappe always sends its native assignment notification (v15 has no per-call suppression), so only true is accepted (default true)

assignment_description.description: Description for the native ToDo assignment

tools.name: erpnext_doc_unassign
tools.description: Remove one user's assignment from any ERPNext document through Frappe's native workflow (closes the user's ToDo and resyncs _assign). Works on any DocType. Pass one user per call. Idempotent: removing a user who is not assigned is a no-op on the Frappe side.

assign_to.description: User email whose assignment should be removed

tools.name: erpnext_method_call
tools.description: Call a whitelisted Frappe method directly (POST or GET /api/method/{method}). Escape hatch for behaviour that is not a plain document write: custom-app @frappe.whitelist methods, validate hooks that reject direct field updates, and GET-only endpoints. Deny-by-default: the method must match an entry in ERPNEXT_METHOD_ALLOWLIST (exact dotted path or 'prefix.*' wildcard), or the call is rejected before it reaches ERPNext. Set ERPNEXT_METHOD_ALLOWLIST=* to allow any method for a fully open session.

method.description: Dotted path to the whitelisted method, e.g. 'frappe.client.get_count' or 'my_app.api.reconcile'.

args.description: Keyword arguments passed to the method.

http_method.description: HTTP verb to use. Defaults to POST. Use GET for methods declared @frappe.whitelist(methods=["GET"]), which reject POST.

invalidate.description: Optional { doctype, name } to drop from the read cache after a mutating call, so the next read reflects the method's side effects.

tools.name: erpnext_purchase_order_create
tools.description: Create a new Purchase Order. Requires supplier and at least one item with item_code, qty, rate. Optionally set schedule_date (YYYY-MM-DD).

supplier.description: Supplier name or ID — a unique name resolves automatically

tools.name: erpnext_purchase_invoice_list
tools.description: List Purchase Invoices (bills from suppliers). Filterable by supplier, status, date range. Fields: name, supplier, posting_date, due_date, status, grand_total, outstanding_amount.

supplier.description: Filter by supplier ID or name (e.g. 'SUPP-00001' or 'Acme Supplies')

status.description: Filter by status (Draft, Unpaid, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled, etc.)

tools.name: erpnext_purchase_invoice_get
tools.description: Get a single Purchase Invoice by name (e.g. PINV-00001). Returns full document with line items.

tools.name: erpnext_purchase_receipt_list
tools.description: List Purchase Receipts (goods received notes). Filterable by supplier, status, date range. Fields: name, supplier, posting_date, status, total_qty, grand_total.

supplier.description: Filter by supplier ID or name (e.g. 'SUPP-00001' or 'Acme Supplies')

status.description: Filter by status (Draft, To Bill, Completed, Cancelled, etc.)

tools.name: erpnext_purchase_receipt_get
tools.description: Get a single Purchase Receipt by name (e.g. MAT-PRE-00001). Returns full document with received items.

tools.name: erpnext_supplier_quotation_list
tools.description: List Supplier Quotations (RFQ responses from suppliers). Filterable by supplier, status. Fields: name, supplier, transaction_date, status, grand_total.

supplier.description: Filter by supplier ID or name (e.g. 'SUPP-00001' or 'Acme Supplies')

status.description: Filter by status (Draft, Submitted, Ordered, Lost, Cancelled)

tools.name: erpnext_customer_list
tools.description: List ERPNext customers. Returns active customers by default. Fields: name, customer_name, customer_group, territory, email_id, disabled.

tools.name: erpnext_customer_get
tools.description: Get a single ERPNext customer by name (ID). Returns all fields including contact details.

tools.name: erpnext_customer_create
tools.description: Create a new Customer. Requires customer_name. Optionally set customer_group, territory, email_id.

customer_type.description: Customer type: Company or Individual (default: Company)

tools.name: erpnext_customer_update
tools.description: Update an existing Customer. Pass only the fields you want to change.

disabled.description: Set to true to disable the customer

tools.name: erpnext_sales_order_list
tools.description: List Sales Orders. Filterable by customer, status, date range. Fields: name, customer, transaction_date, status, grand_total, currency.

customer.description: Filter by customer ID or name (e.g. 'CUST-00001' or 'Acme Corp')

status.description: Filter by status (Draft, To Deliver and Bill, Completed, Cancelled, etc.)

tools.name: erpnext_sales_order_get
tools.description: Get a single Sales Order by name (e.g. SO-00001). Returns full document with line items.

tools.name: erpnext_sales_order_create
tools.description: Create a new Sales Order. Requires customer and at least one item with item_code, qty, rate. On a fresh ERPNext instance, you may also need to set company, selling_price_list, and currency.

company.description: Company name. Required if multiple companies exist.

selling_price_list.description: Price list name (e.g. 'Standard Selling'). Required if no default is set.

currency.description: Transaction currency (e.g. 'EUR', 'USD'). Defaults to company currency.

set_warehouse.description: Default warehouse for all items (e.g. 'Stores - CI').

tools.name: erpnext_sales_order_update
tools.description: Update an existing Sales Order (only in Draft status). Pass only the fields you want to change (e.g. delivery_date, items).

tools.name: erpnext_sales_order_submit
tools.description: Submit a Draft Sales Order (changes status to 'To Deliver and Bill'). Triggers stock reservation and fulfillment workflow.

tools.name: erpnext_sales_order_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a submitted Sales Order. Reverses stock reservation. Only works on submitted (non-completed) Sales Orders.

tools.name: erpnext_sales_invoice_list
tools.description: List Sales Invoices. Filterable by customer, status, date range. Fields: name, customer, posting_date, due_date, status, grand_total, outstanding_amount.

customer.description: Filter by customer ID or name (e.g. 'CUST-00001' or 'Acme Corp')

status.description: Filter by status (Draft, Unpaid, Paid, Overdue, Cancelled, etc.)

tools.name: erpnext_sales_invoice_get
tools.description: Get a single Sales Invoice by name (e.g. SINV-00001). Returns full document with line items.

tools.name: erpnext_sales_invoice_create
tools.description: Create a new Sales Invoice. Requires customer and at least one item. On a fresh ERPNext instance, you may also need to set company, selling_price_list, and currency. To generate from a Sales Order, use erpnext_doc_update to set is_return etc.

company.description: Company name. Required if multiple companies exist.

selling_price_list.description: Price list name (e.g. 'Standard Selling'). Required if no default is set.

currency.description: Transaction currency (e.g. 'EUR', 'USD'). Defaults to company currency.

tools.name: erpnext_sales_invoice_submit
tools.description: Submit a Draft Sales Invoice (posts it to the ledger, changes status to 'Unpaid'). Once submitted, the invoice is visible to the customer and affects GL.

tools.name: erpnext_quotation_list
tools.description: List Quotations. Filterable by party_name, status. Fields: name, party_name, transaction_date, status, grand_total.

quotation_to.description: Party type: Customer or Lead. Required when 'party_name' is set, so the party name/ID can be resolved against the right doctype.

party_name.description: Filter by party — ID or name (e.g. customer/lead name). Requires 'quotation_to'.

status.description: Filter by status (Draft, Open, Replied, Ordered, Lost, Cancelled)

tools.name: erpnext_quotation_get
tools.description: Get a single Quotation by name. Returns full document with line items and terms.

tools.name: erpnext_quotation_create
tools.description: Create a new Quotation for a customer or lead. Requires quotation_to (Customer or Lead), party_name, and at least one item.

party_name.description: Customer or Lead — ID or name

company.description: Company name. Required if multiple companies exist.

tools.name: erpnext_user_list
tools.description: List assignable ERPNext users. Defaults to enabled System Users, excluding Administrator and Guest — the population valid for document assignment (erpnext_doc_assign, task assign_to). Fields: name (email), full_name, enabled.

tools.name: erpnext_company_list
tools.description: List ERPNext companies. Fields: name, abbr, default_currency, country, domain.

tools.name: erpnext_company_create
tools.description: Create an ERPNext Company. Requires company_name, abbr, default_currency, country. Prerequisites: Warehouse Type 'Transit' and 'Default' must exist. Use erpnext_doc_create to create them first if needed.

domain.description: Business domain (Manufacturing, Services, Retail, Distribution, Education, etc.)
